BEGIN
  -- Allow if superuser / postgres / service_role OR if authenticated user is admin
  IF current_user NOT IN ('postgres', 'service_role') AND NOT is_user_admin(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    p.name,
    u.email,
    p.avatar,
    COALESCE(p.is_admin, false) AS is_admin
  FROM public.user_profiles p
  LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = p.id;
END;

definition:
DECLARE
  v_donations JSON;
  v_withdrawals JSON;
BEGIN
  -- Get recent donations
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(d ORDER BY d.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_donations
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ad.id,
      ad.created_at,
      ad.net_amount AS amount,
      ad.donor_message AS message,
      ad.anonymous,
      CASE
        WHEN ad.anonymous THEN NULL
        ELSE p.name
      END AS donor_name,
      CASE
        WHEN ad.anonymous THEN NULL
        ELSE p.avatar
      END AS donor_avatar
    FROM area_donations ad
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.id = ad.user_id
    WHERE ad.area_id = p_area_id
    ORDER BY ad.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 20
  ) d;

  -- Get fulfilled/delivered material requests
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(w ORDER BY w.delivered_at DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_withdrawals
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.id,
      COALESCE(r.updated_at, r.created_at) AS delivered_at,
      r.total_amount AS amount,
      r.notes,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
          'name', m.name,
          'quantity', i.quantity,
          'unit', m.unit
        ))
        FROM area_material_request_items i
        JOIN material_catalog m ON m.id = i.material_id
        WHERE i.request_id = r.id
      ), '[]'::json) AS items
    FROM area_material_requests r
    WHERE r.area_id = p_area_id
      AND r.status = 'disposed'
    ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 20
  ) w;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'donations', v_donations,
    'withdrawals', v_withdrawals
  );
END;

name: get_areas_list
return_type: TABLE(climbing_kind climbing_kind[], crags_count integer, topos_count integer, grades jsonb, id integer, liked boolean, name text, shade_afternoon boolean, shade_all_day boolean, shade_morning boolean, slug text, sun_all_day boolean, user_creator_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
definition:
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH topos_per_area AS (
      SELECT c.area_id, count(*)::integer AS topos_count
      FROM public.topos t
      JOIN public.crags c ON t.crag_id = c.id
      GROUP BY c.area_id
    ),
    crags_per_area AS (
      SELECT c.area_id, count(*)::integer AS crags_count
      FROM public.crags c
      GROUP BY c.area_id
    ),
    likes AS (
      SELECT al.area_id, true AS liked
      FROM public.area_likes al
      WHERE al.user_id = auth.uid()
    ),
    grades_per_area AS (
      SELECT r_area.area_id,
             jsonb_object_agg(r_area.grade::text, r_area.cnt) AS grades
      FROM (
        SELECT cr.area_id, r.grade, count(*) AS cnt
        FROM public.routes r
        JOIN public.crags cr ON cr.id = r.crag_id
        WHERE r.grade IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cr.area_id, r.grade
        HAVING count(*) > 0
        ORDER BY cr.area_id, r.grade
      ) r_area
      GROUP BY r_area.area_id
    ),
    kinds_per_area AS (
      SELECT cr.area_id,
             array_agg(DISTINCT r.climbing_kind) FILTER (WHERE r.climbing_kind IS NOT NULL) AS climbing_kinds
      FROM public.routes r
      JOIN public.crags cr ON cr.id = r.crag_id
      GROUP BY cr.area_id
    ),
    shade_flags_per_area AS (
      SELECT
        cr.area_id,
        bool_or(t.shade_morning = true  AND t.shade_afternoon = true)  AS shade_all_day,
        bool_or(t.shade_morning = true  AND (t.shade_afternoon IS FALSE OR t.shade_afternoon = false))  AS shade_morning,
        bool_or((t.shade_morning IS FALSE OR t.shade_morning = false) AND t.shade_afternoon = true)  AS shade_afternoon,
        bool_or((t.shade_morning IS FALSE OR t.shade_morning = false) AND (t.shade_afternoon IS FALSE OR t.shade_afternoon = false)) AS sun_all_day
      FROM public.topos t
      JOIN public.crags cr ON cr.id = t.crag_id
      GROUP BY cr.area_id
    ),
    base AS (
      SELECT
        a.id::integer AS id,
        a.name,
        a.slug,
        COALESCE(l.liked, false) AS liked,
        COALESCE(cpa.crags_count, 0)::integer AS crags_count,
        COALESCE(tpa.topos_count, 0)::integer AS topos_count,
        COALESCE(gpa.grades, '{}'::jsonb) AS grades,
        COALESCE(kpa.climbing_kinds, ARRAY[]::public.climbing_kind[]) AS climbing_kind,
        COALESCE(sfa.shade_all_day, false) AS shade_all_day,
        COALESCE(sfa.shade_morning, false) AS shade_morning,
        COALESCE(sfa.shade_afternoon, false) AS shade_afternoon,
        COALESCE(sfa.sun_all_day, false) AS sun_all_day,
        a.user_creator_id,
        a.created_at
      FROM public.areas a
      LEFT JOIN crags_per_area cpa ON cpa.area_id = a.id
      LEFT JOIN topos_per_area tpa ON tpa.area_id = a.id
      LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.area_id = a.id
      LEFT JOIN grades_per_area gpa ON gpa.area_id = a.id
      LEFT JOIN kinds_per_area kpa ON kpa.area_id = a.id
      LEFT JOIN shade_flags_per_area sfa ON sfa.area_id = a.id
    )
    SELECT
        base.climbing_kind, base.crags_count, base.topos_count, base.grades,
        base.id, base.liked, base.name, base.shade_afternoon, base.shade_all_day,
        base.shade_morning, base.slug, base.sun_all_day, base.user_creator_id, base.created_at
    FROM base
    ORDER BY (base.liked::int) DESC, base.name ASC;
END;

name: get_crags_list
return_type: TABLE(climbing_kind climbing_kind[], topos_count bigint, topos jsonb, routes_count bigint, grades jsonb, id integer, liked boolean, name text, shade_afternoon boolean, shade_all_day boolean, shade_morning boolean, slug text, sun_all_day boolean, user_creator_id uuid, area_id integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, area_name text, area_slug text)
definition:
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH likes AS (
      SELECT cl.crag_id, true AS liked
      FROM public.crag_likes cl
      WHERE cl.user_id = auth.uid()
    ),
    kinds_per_crag AS (
      SELECT r.crag_id,
        array_agg(DISTINCT r.climbing_kind) FILTER (WHERE r.climbing_kind IS NOT NULL) AS climbing_kinds,
        count(*) AS routes_count
      FROM public.routes r
      GROUP BY r.crag_id
    ),
    grades_per_crag AS (
      SELECT r_crag.crag_id,
             jsonb_object_agg(r_crag.grade::text, r_crag.cnt) AS grades
      FROM (
        SELECT r.crag_id, r.grade, count(*) AS cnt
        FROM public.routes r
        WHERE r.grade IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY r.crag_id, r.grade
        HAVING count(*) > 0
        ORDER BY r.crag_id, r.grade
      ) r_crag
      GROUP BY r_crag.crag_id
    ),
    shade_flags_per_crag AS (
      SELECT
        cr.id AS crag_id,
        bool_or(t.shade_morning = true  AND t.shade_afternoon = true)  AS shade_all_day,
        bool_or(t.shade_morning = true  AND (t.shade_afternoon IS FALSE OR t.shade_afternoon = false))  AS shade_morning,
        bool_or((t.shade_morning IS FALSE OR t.shade_morning = false) AND t.shade_afternoon = true)  AS shade_afternoon,
        bool_or((t.shade_morning IS FALSE OR t.shade_morning = false) AND (t.shade_afternoon IS FALSE OR t.shade_afternoon = false)) AS sun_all_day,
        count(t.*)::bigint AS topos_count,
        COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'name', t.name, 'slug', t.slug)) FILTER (WHERE t.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS topos
      FROM public.crags cr
      LEFT JOIN public.topos t ON cr.id = t.crag_id
      GROUP BY cr.id
    )
    SELECT
      COALESCE(kpa.climbing_kinds, ARRAY[]::public.climbing_kind[]) AS climbing_kind,
      COALESCE(sfc.topos_count, 0) AS topos_count,
      COALESCE(sfc.topos, '[]'::jsonb) AS topos,
      COALESCE(kpa.routes_count, 0) AS routes_count,
      COALESCE(gpc.grades, '{}'::jsonb) AS grades,
      c.id::integer AS id,
      COALESCE(l.liked, false) AS liked,
      c.name,
      COALESCE(sfc.shade_afternoon, false) AS shade_afternoon,
      COALESCE(sfc.shade_all_day, false) AS shade_all_day,
      COALESCE(sfc.shade_morning, false) AS shade_morning,
      c.slug,
      COALESCE(sfc.sun_all_day, false) AS sun_all_day,
      c.user_creator_id,
      c.area_id::integer AS area_id,
      c.created_at,
      a.name AS area_name,
      a.slug AS area_slug
    FROM public.crags c
           JOIN public.areas a ON c.area_id = a.id
           LEFT JOIN kinds_per_crag kpa ON kpa.crag_id = c.id
           LEFT JOIN grades_per_crag gpc ON gpc.crag_id = c.id
           LEFT JOIN shade_flags_per_crag sfc ON sfc.crag_id = c.id
           LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.crag_id = c.id
    ORDER BY (COALESCE(l.liked, false)::int) DESC, c.name ASC;
END;

name: get_indoor_centers_in_bounds
arguments: min_lat double precision, min_lng double precision, max_lat double precision, max_lng double precision
return_type: TABLE(id uuid, name text, slug text, location text)
definition:
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    ic.id,
    ic.name,
    ic.slug,
    ST_AsText(ic.location) as location
  FROM
    public.indoor_centers ic
  WHERE
    ic.location && ST_MakeEnvelope(min_lng, min_lat, max_lng, max_lat, 4326);
END;

name: get_user_statistics
definition:
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        ra.date as ascent_date,
        ra.type::TEXT as ascent_type,
        ra.grade as ascent_grade,
        r.grade as route_grade,
        r.name as route_name,
        r.slug as route_slug,
        c.slug as crag_slug,
        a.slug as area_slug
    FROM route_ascents ra
    INNER JOIN routes r ON ra.route_id = r.id
    INNER JOIN crags c ON r.crag_id = c.id
    INNER JOIN areas a ON c.area_id = a.id
    WHERE ra.user_id = p_user_id
    ORDER BY ra.date DESC;
END;

definition:
declare
  normalized_query text;
  results jsonb;
begin
  -- Normalize query: remove accents
  normalized_query := unaccent(lower(p_query));
  
  with matched_areas as (
    select 
      'area' as type,
      name as title,
      '/area/' || slug as href,
      '@tui.map-pin' as icon,
      null::text as subtitle,
      null::int as difficulty,
      null::climbing_kind as climbing_kind,
      null::jsonb as data,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(name)), normalized_query) as sml
    from areas
    where unaccent(lower(name)) % normalized_query or name ilike '%' || p_query || '%'
    order by sml desc
    limit 5
  ),
  matched_crags as (
    select 
      'crag' as type,
      c.name as title,
      '/area/' || a.slug || '/' || c.slug as href,
      '@tui.mountain' as icon,
      a.name as subtitle,
      null::int as difficulty,
      null::climbing_kind as climbing_kind,
      null::jsonb as data,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(c.name)), normalized_query) as sml
    from crags c
    join areas a on c.area_id = a.id
    where unaccent(lower(c.name)) % normalized_query or c.name ilike '%' || p_query || '%'
    order by sml desc
    limit 5
  ),
  matched_routes as (
    select 
      'route' as type,
      r.name as title,
      '/area/' || a.slug || '/' || c.slug || '/' || r.slug as href,
      '@tui.route' as icon,
      a.name || ' > ' || c.name as subtitle,
      r.grade as difficulty,
      r.climbing_kind as climbing_kind,
      null::jsonb as data,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(r.name)), normalized_query) as sml
    from routes r
    join crags c on r.crag_id = c.id
    join areas a on c.area_id = a.id
    where unaccent(lower(r.name)) % normalized_query or r.name ilike '%' || p_query || '%'
    order by sml desc
    limit 10
  ),
  matched_users as (
    select 
      'user' as type,
      name as title,
      '/profile/' || id as href,
      avatar as icon,
      null::text as subtitle,
      null::int as difficulty,
      null::climbing_kind as climbing_kind,
      jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'avatar', avatar) as data,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(name)), normalized_query) as sml
    from user_profiles
    where unaccent(lower(name)) % normalized_query or name ilike '%' || p_query || '%'
    order by sml desc
    limit 5
  ),
  matched_indoors as (
    select 
      'indoor' as type,
      name as title,
      '/indoor/' || slug as href,
      avatar_url as icon,
      city as subtitle,
      null::int as difficulty,
      null::climbing_kind as climbing_kind,
      jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'avatar_url', avatar_url) as data,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(name)), normalized_query) as sml
    from indoor_centers
    where unaccent(lower(name)) % normalized_query or name ilike '%' || p_query || '%'
    order by sml desc
    limit 5
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'areas', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ma) - 'sml') from matched_areas ma), '[]'::jsonb),
    'crags', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mc) - 'sml') from matched_crags mc), '[]'::jsonb),
    'routes', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mr) - 'sml') from matched_routes mr), '[]'::jsonb),
    'users', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mu) - 'sml') from matched_users mu), '[]'::jsonb),
    'indoors', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mi) - 'sml') from matched_indoors mi), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into results;

  return results;
end;
